templates.github:
# Premium CI preview. Server access stays disabled until #467.
# Copy to .github/workflows/argos-ci.yml; configure the protected argos-ci environment.
name: Argos Premium CI
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      operation:
        description: Audit, or read-only refresh of an existing intention
        type: choice
        options: [audit, resume]
        default: audit
      original_intent:
        description: Original intention UUID, required for resume (never creates an analysis)
        type: string
        required: false
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: argos-ci-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  NODE_OPTIONS: ''
  NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED: '1'
  ARGOS_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
  ARGOS_ENVIRONMENT: production
  ARGOS_LANG: fr

jobs:
  argos_control:
    if: ${{ github.event.repository.fork == false && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch) && (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    environment: argos-ci
    outputs:
      audit_outcome: ${{ steps.control.outputs.audit_outcome }}
      evidence_sha256: ${{ steps.control.outputs.evidence_sha256 }}
      evidence_invocation: ${{ steps.control.outputs.evidence_invocation }}
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
      cipher_sha256: ${{ steps.seal.outputs.cipher_sha256 }}
      encrypted_artifact_id: ${{ steps.encrypted_upload.outputs.artifact-id }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: '24.21.0'
      - name: Download the reviewed standalone client (no project checkout)
        run: |
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 --max-redirs 0 --max-filesize 1048576 \
            --output argos-ci.mjs https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dokor/argos/e3303d9aafcf9924b3e578aceb22ad98383dca3c/clients/ci/dist/argos-ci.mjs
          echo '283b74c313ffe25ebe736ac77bc9ab05742d23f4787298544d5f69bb2a75f03b  argos-ci.mjs' | sha256sum --check --strict
      - name: Admit two samples and consume the confirmed server verdict
        id: control
        shell: bash
        run: |
          case "$ARGOS_CI_OPERATION" in
            audit) test -z "$ARGOS_ORIGINAL_INTENT" || exit 2 ;;
            resume) export ARGOS_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY="$ARGOS_ORIGINAL_INTENT" ;;
            *) exit 2 ;;
          esac
          set +e
          node argos-ci.mjs "$ARGOS_CI_OPERATION" > control-result.json
          status=$?
          set -e
          node --input-type=module -e '
            import fs from "node:fs";
            const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("control-result.json","utf8"));
            if(!["GO","SITE_NO_GO","CONTROL_FAILED"].includes(r.auditOutcome))process.exit(2);
            const digest=/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(r.evidenceSha256??"")?r.evidenceSha256:"";
            const invocation=process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ID+":"+process.env.GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT;
            if(!/^[1-9][0-9]{0,19}:[1-9][0-9]{0,5}$/.test(invocation))process.exit(2);
            fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT,"audit_outcome="+r.auditOutcome+"\nevidence_sha256="+digest+"\nevidence_invocation="+invocation+"\n");
            console.log(JSON.stringify(r));'
          exit "$status"
        env:
          ARGOS_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ARGOS_API_KEY }}
          ARGOS_CI_OPERATION: ${{ inputs.operation || 'audit' }}
          ARGOS_ORIGINAL_INTENT: ${{ inputs.original_intent || '' }}
          ARGOS_TARGET_URL: ${{ vars.ARGOS_TARGET_URL }}
          ARGOS_EXPORT_PRIVATE: ${{ (vars.ARGOS_PRIVATE_ARTIFACTS == 'true' || vars.ARGOS_PUBLICATION_PREVIEW == 'true' || vars.ARGOS_GITHUB_PUBLISH == 'true') && '1' || '' }}
      - name: Seal publication evidence with the private registry key (no Git write permission)
        id: seal
        if: ${{ always() && vars.ARGOS_GITHUB_PUBLISH == 'true' && (steps.control.outputs.audit_outcome == 'GO' || steps.control.outputs.audit_outcome == 'SITE_NO_GO') && steps.control.outputs.evidence_sha256 != '' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set +e
          node argos-ci.mjs publication-stage > seal-result.json
          status=$?
          set -e
          node --input-type=module -e '
            import fs from "node:fs";
            const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("seal-result.json","utf8"));
            if(r.proofStaged===true && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(r.cipherSha256??""))
              fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT,"cipher_sha256="+r.cipherSha256+"\n");
            console.log(JSON.stringify(r));'
          exit "$status"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ARGOS_GITHUB_JOURNAL_READ_SAS_URL: ${{ secrets.ARGOS_GITHUB_JOURNAL_READ_SAS_URL }}
          ARGOS_PUBLICATION_CONFIG: ${{ vars.ARGOS_PUBLICATION_CONFIG }}
          ARGOS_EVIDENCE_SHA256: ${{ steps.control.outputs.evidence_sha256 }}
          ARGOS_EVIDENCE_PRODUCER: argos_control
      - name: Transfer encrypted evidence only (also safe for a public repository)
        id: encrypted_upload
        if: ${{ always() && steps.seal.outputs.cipher_sha256 != '' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6
        with:
          name: argos-encrypted-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .argos-ci/evidence.enc.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7
      - name: Verify private destination immediately before upload
        id: destination
        if: ${{ always() && (vars.ARGOS_PRIVATE_ARTIFACTS == 'true' || vars.ARGOS_PUBLICATION_PREVIEW == 'true') && (steps.control.outputs.audit_outcome == 'GO' || steps.control.outputs.audit_outcome == 'SITE_NO_GO') && steps.control.outputs.evidence_sha256 != '' }}
        run: node argos-ci.mjs artifact-check
        env:
          ARGOS_GITHUB_READ_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Opt-in private evidence (never raw reports or diagnostics)
        id: upload
        if: ${{ always() && steps.destination.outcome == 'success' && steps.control.outputs.evidence_sha256 != '' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6
        with:
          name: argos-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .argos-ci/evidence.json
          include-hidden-files: true
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  argos_preview:
    # Read-only preview remains independently optional.
    needs: argos_control
    if: ${{ always() && vars.ARGOS_PUBLICATION_PREVIEW == 'true' && github.event.repository.fork == false && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch) && (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && (needs.argos_control.outputs.audit_outcome == 'GO' || needs.argos_control.outputs.audit_outcome == 'SITE_NO_GO') && needs.argos_control.outputs.artifact_id != '' && needs.argos_control.outputs.evidence_sha256 != '' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: '24.21.0'
      - name: Download the same reviewed client
        run: |
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 --max-redirs 0 --max-filesize 1048576 \
            --output argos-ci.mjs https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dokor/argos/e3303d9aafcf9924b3e578aceb22ad98383dca3c/clients/ci/dist/argos-ci.mjs
          echo '283b74c313ffe25ebe736ac77bc9ab05742d23f4787298544d5f69bb2a75f03b  argos-ci.mjs' | sha256sum --check --strict
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@37930b1c2abaa49bbe596cd826c3c89aef350131 # v7
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.argos_control.outputs.artifact_id }}
          path: .argos-ci
      - name: Verify producer, digest, schema and preview eligible findings
        run: node argos-ci.mjs publication-preview
        env:
          ARGOS_EVIDENCE_SHA256: ${{ needs.argos_control.outputs.evidence_sha256 }}
          ARGOS_EVIDENCE_PRODUCER: argos_control

  argos_publish:
    needs: argos_control
    if: ${{ always() && vars.ARGOS_GITHUB_PUBLISH == 'true' && github.event.repository.fork == false && github.ref == format('refs/heads/{0}', github.event.repository.default_branch) && (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && (needs.argos_control.outputs.audit_outcome == 'GO' || needs.argos_control.outputs.audit_outcome == 'SITE_NO_GO') && needs.argos_control.outputs.encrypted_artifact_id != '' && needs.argos_control.outputs.cipher_sha256 != '' && needs.argos_control.outputs.evidence_sha256 != '' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    environment: argos-publisher
    # Same group across all publisher workflows, refs, environments and run attempts.
    # The blob lease + ETag remains authoritative across repositories/runners and cancellation.
    concurrency:
      group: argos-github-issues-${{ github.repository_id }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      actions: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: '24.21.0'
      - name: Download the same reviewed client
        run: |
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 --max-redirs 0 --max-filesize 1048576 \
            --output argos-ci.mjs https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dokor/argos/e3303d9aafcf9924b3e578aceb22ad98383dca3c/clients/ci/dist/argos-ci.mjs
          echo '283b74c313ffe25ebe736ac77bc9ab05742d23f4787298544d5f69bb2a75f03b  argos-ci.mjs' | sha256sum --check --strict
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@37930b1c2abaa49bbe596cd826c3c89aef350131 # v7
        with:
          artifact-ids: ${{ needs.argos_control.outputs.encrypted_artifact_id }}
          path: .argos-ci
      - name: Publish confirmed findings with the job token
        run: node argos-ci.mjs publish-github
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ARGOS_GITHUB_JOURNAL_SAS_URL: ${{ secrets.ARGOS_GITHUB_JOURNAL_SAS_URL }}
          ARGOS_PUBLICATION_CONFIG: ${{ vars.ARGOS_PUBLICATION_CONFIG }}
          ARGOS_EVIDENCE_SHA256: ${{ needs.argos_control.outputs.evidence_sha256 }}
          ARGOS_CIPHER_SHA256: ${{ needs.argos_control.outputs.cipher_sha256 }}
          ARGOS_EVIDENCE_PRODUCER: argos_control
          ARGOS_EVIDENCE_INVOCATION: ${{ needs.argos_control.outputs.evidence_invocation }}
templates.gitlab:
# GitLab.com: dedicated protected Linux shell runner tagged argos-ci, Node 24.21.0 + curl.
# No deployment, project checkout, cache or project scripts. Server closed until #467.
stages: [argos_control, argos_preview]
default:
  tags: [argos-ci]
  before_script: []
  after_script: []
  cache: []
variables:
  GIT_STRATEGY: empty
  NODE_OPTIONS: ''
  NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED: '1'
  ARGOS_ENVIRONMENT: production
  ARGOS_LANG: fr
  ARGOS_PRIVATE_ARTIFACTS: 'false'
  ARGOS_PUBLICATION_PREVIEW: 'false'

.argos_rules:
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_SERVER_URL == "https://gitlab.com" && $CI_COMMIT_REF_PROTECTED == "true" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH && ($CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" || $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web" || $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule")'
    - when: never

.argos_download:
  script:
    - test "$(node --version)" = 'v24.21.0'
    - >-
      curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 --max-redirs 0 --max-filesize 1048576
      --output argos-ci.mjs https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dokor/argos/e3303d9aafcf9924b3e578aceb22ad98383dca3c/clients/ci/dist/argos-ci.mjs
    - echo '283b74c313ffe25ebe736ac77bc9ab05742d23f4787298544d5f69bb2a75f03b  argos-ci.mjs' | sha256sum --check --strict

argos_control:
  extends: .argos_rules
  stage: argos_control
  timeout: 25 minutes
  environment:
    name: argos-ci
  script:
    - !reference [.argos_download, script]
    - |
      unset ARGOS_EXPORT_PRIVATE
      if [ "$ARGOS_PRIVATE_ARTIFACTS" = true ] || [ "$ARGOS_PUBLICATION_PREVIEW" = true ]; then
        env -u ARGOS_API_KEY node argos-ci.mjs artifact-check || exit 2
        export ARGOS_EXPORT_PRIVATE=1
      fi
      set +e
      env -u ARGOS_GITLAB_READ_TOKEN node argos-ci.mjs audit
      status=$?
      set -e
      if [ "${ARGOS_EXPORT_PRIVATE:-}" = 1 ] && [ "$status" -le 1 ]; then
        # Recheck confidentiality/keep_latest_artifact right before provider upload.
        if ! env -u ARGOS_API_KEY node argos-ci.mjs artifact-check; then
          node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; fs.unlinkSync(".argos-ci/evidence.json")'
          exit 2
        fi
      fi
      exit "$status"
  artifacts:
    when: always
    access: maintainer
    expire_in: 7 days
    paths: [.argos-ci/evidence.json]

argos_preview:
  # Read-only preview. For optional issue publishing use gitlab-publication.yml instead.
  stage: argos_preview
  timeout: 5 minutes
  environment:
    name: argos-publication-preview
  dependencies: [argos_control]
  rules:
    - if: '$ARGOS_PUBLICATION_PREVIEW == "true" && $CI_PROJECT_VISIBILITY == "private" && $CI_SERVER_URL == "https://gitlab.com" && $CI_COMMIT_REF_PROTECTED == "true" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH && ($CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" || $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web" || $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule")'
      when: always
    - when: never
  script:
    - !reference [.argos_download, script]
    # API: select the exact current-pipeline producer and obtain its digest OUTSIDE the artifact.
    - env -u ARGOS_API_KEY node argos-ci.mjs publication-preview
templates.gitlabPublication:
# GitLab.com optional issue publication. Use INSTEAD OF gitlab-ci.yml, not together.
# Dedicated protected Linux shell runner, Node 24.21.0 + curl; no checkout/project hooks.
# Protect default branch and environments. Keep Argos CI closed until #467.
stages: [argos_control, argos_publish]
default:
  tags: [argos-ci]
  before_script: []
  after_script: []
  cache: []
variables:
  GIT_STRATEGY: empty
  NODE_OPTIONS: ''
  NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED: '1'
  ARGOS_ENVIRONMENT: production
  ARGOS_LANG: fr
  ARGOS_GITLAB_PUBLISH: 'false'
  ARGOS_CI_OPERATION: audit
  ARGOS_ORIGINAL_INTENT: ''
  ARGOS_GITLAB_CREDENTIAL_KIND: project-token

.argos_publication_rules:
  rules:
    - if: '$CI_SERVER_URL == "https://gitlab.com" && $CI_COMMIT_REF_PROTECTED == "true" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH && ($CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" || $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web" || $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule")'
    - when: never

.argos_download:
  script:
    - test "$(node --version)" = 'v24.21.0'
    - >-
      curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 --max-redirs 0 --max-filesize 1048576
      --output argos-ci.mjs https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dokor/argos/e3303d9aafcf9924b3e578aceb22ad98383dca3c/clients/ci/dist/argos-ci.mjs
    - echo '283b74c313ffe25ebe736ac77bc9ab05742d23f4787298544d5f69bb2a75f03b  argos-ci.mjs' | sha256sum --check --strict

argos_control:
  extends: .argos_publication_rules
  stage: argos_control
  dependencies: []
  timeout: 25 minutes
  environment:
    name: argos-ci
  script:
    - !reference [.argos_download, script]
    - |
      case "$ARGOS_CI_OPERATION" in
        audit) test -z "$ARGOS_ORIGINAL_INTENT" || exit 2 ;;
        resume) export ARGOS_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY="$ARGOS_ORIGINAL_INTENT" ;;
        *) exit 2 ;;
      esac
      unset ARGOS_EXPORT_PRIVATE
      if [ "$ARGOS_GITLAB_PUBLISH" = true ]; then export ARGOS_EXPORT_PRIVATE=1; fi
      set +e
      env -u ARGOS_GITLAB_READ_TOKEN node argos-ci.mjs "$ARGOS_CI_OPERATION" > control-result.json
      status=$?
      set -e
      # Only the client's reconstructed JSON is logged; no audited text or response body.
      cat control-result.json
      if [ "$status" -gt 1 ] || [ "$ARGOS_GITLAB_PUBLISH" != true ]; then exit "$status"; fi
      ARGOS_EVIDENCE_SHA256=$(node --input-type=module -e '
        import fs from "node:fs";
        const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("control-result.json","utf8"));
        if(!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(r.evidenceSha256??""))process.exit(3);
        process.stdout.write(r.evidenceSha256);')
      export ARGOS_EVIDENCE_SHA256
      set +e
      env -u ARGOS_API_KEY node argos-ci.mjs publication-stage
      sealed=$?
      set -e
      # Plain evidence is never in artifacts, including forced cancellation/error paths.
      node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; fs.unlinkSync(".argos-ci/evidence.json")'
      if [ "$sealed" -gt 1 ]; then exit "$sealed"; fi
      exit "$status"
  artifacts:
    when: always
    access: maintainer
    expire_in: 7 days
    paths: [.argos-ci/evidence.enc.json]

argos_publish:
  rules:
    - if: '$ARGOS_GITLAB_PUBLISH == "true" && $CI_SERVER_URL == "https://gitlab.com" && $CI_COMMIT_REF_PROTECTED == "true" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == $CI_DEFAULT_BRANCH && ($CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" || $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web" || $CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "schedule")'
      when: always
    - when: never
  stage: argos_publish
  timeout: 5 minutes
  environment:
    name: argos-publisher
  # Provider queue reduces collisions. The private blob lease + ETag is authoritative.
  resource_group: argos-gitlab-issues-${CI_PROJECT_ID}
  dependencies: [argos_control]
  script:
    - !reference [.argos_download, script]
    # Read-only API/trace proof selects the current pipeline producer before any mutation.
    - env -u ARGOS_API_KEY node argos-ci.mjs publish-gitlab
